indexes.name: claim_leases_claim_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX claim_leases_claim_id_key ON public.claim_leases USING btree (claim_id)

indexes.name: claim_leases_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX claim_leases_pkey ON public.claim_leases USING btree (lease_id)

indexes.name: idx_active_lease_expiry
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_active_lease_expiry ON public.claim_leases USING btree (expires_at) WHERE (lease_status = 'ACTIVE'::text)

indexes.name: claim_requests_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX claim_requests_pkey ON public.claim_requests USING btree (request_id)

indexes.name: donation_claims_claim_id_listing_id_ngo_user_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX donation_claims_claim_id_listing_id_ngo_user_id_key ON public.donation_claims USING btree (claim_id, listing_id, ngo_user_id)

indexes.name: donation_claims_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX donation_claims_pkey ON public.donation_claims USING btree (claim_id)

indexes.name: donation_claims_request_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX donation_claims_request_id_key ON public.donation_claims USING btree (request_id)

indexes.name: ux_active_claim
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_active_claim ON public.donation_claims USING btree (listing_id) WHERE (claim_status = ANY (ARRAY['ACTIVE'::text, 'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'::text]))

indexes.name: listings_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX listings_pkey ON public.listings USING btree (listing_id)

indexes.name: ux_batch_listing
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_batch_listing ON public.listings USING btree (batch_id) WHERE (source_type = 'HUB_BATCH'::text)

indexes.name: ux_direct_listing
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_direct_listing ON public.listings USING btree (donation_id) WHERE (source_type = 'DIRECT_DONATION'::text)

indexes.name: pickup_tasks_claim_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX pickup_tasks_claim_id_key ON public.pickup_tasks USING btree (claim_id)

indexes.name: pickup_tasks_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX pickup_tasks_pkey ON public.pickup_tasks USING btree (task_id)

constraints.name: listing_eligibility_refresh_jobs_listing_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (listing_id) REFERENCES listings(listing_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: listings_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((source_type = 'DIRECT_DONATION'::text) AND (donation_id IS NOT NULL) AND (batch_id IS NULL)) OR ((source_type = 'HUB_BATCH'::text) AND (batch_id IS NOT NULL) AND (donation_id IS NULL))))

constraints.name: pickup_tasks_claim_id_listing_id_ngo_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (claim_id, listing_id, ngo_user_id) REFERENCES donation_claims(claim_id, listing_id, ngo_user_id)
